name: Ronde van Vlaanderen ME
story: An early break of 13 riders built a lead of around 5:30 before being caught with 80 km remaining. Florian Vermeersch's acceleration on the Molenberg sparked the race's decisive move. Pogacar and Van der Poel dropped the field on the Oude Kwaremont, with Evenepoel unable to bridge. Pogacar attacked again with 18.5 km to go, soloing to victory in Oudenaarde ahead of Van der Poel and Evenepoel.
